_doc: (#2902 step 2b review, 5.0) The ONE value domain both sums read a count in: a finite number is floored to an integer and clamped to [0, 2^53]; anything else (a string, a bool, null, a negative number) reads as 0 and reports nothing. `cached_tokens` is present when the record carries a finite number (then read the same way, so -3 is a reported 0), absent otherwise. `dispatch complete` records in domain.jsonl carry counts of every shape on purpose: none of them is read. Shared by the viewer's TS tests and the Rust aggregator.
